card.title: We Always Did This
card.instruction: Treat the strangest behavior in the scene as an old shared tradition that needs no explanation and deserves immediate continuation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set the invisible ancestor's chair by the window again. Pass his plate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's our last chair. Where does my boyfriend sit?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On the piano stool, like every newcomer. Your father managed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought the pudding. Can't the ancestor share?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Pudding bearers sit on his lap. Put a cushion down, as usual.
